instruction: Add two new local folders to Thunderbird: one called FINANCE and another called INVOICES.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating two local folders in Thunderbird (FINANCE and INVOICES). Evaluator checks for both folder files and .msf metadata files. Same complexity as original task with different folder names.
metadata.verification: Verified evaluator checks for FINANCE and INVOICES folders and their .msf files using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete coverage: Evaluator checks both required folders (FINANCE and INVOICES)
Correct state extraction: Postconfig runs 'ls -R' on the correct Thunderbird local folders directory
Thunderbird-aware: Correctly checks for both directory and .msf metadata file for each folder
Appropriate metric: check_list uses regex pattern matching suitable for ls output
Minor regex pattern concern: Patterns use negative lookahead (?!\.msf) which may not optimally match ls -R directory format (directories appear with colon, e.g., 'FINANCE:')
Practical functionality: Despite pattern concerns, evaluator will likely work correctly in practice as patterns will match both directory listings and .msf files
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider using more explicit regex patterns: '\bFINANCE:' for directory listing and '\bFINANCE\.msf\b' for metadata file
Alternative approach: Use separate patterns '\bFINANCE\.msf\b' for the file and '\bFINANCE:?\s*$' for the directory to handle both 'FINANCE:' and 'FINANCE/' formats
